finder_description: A Finder flag on day t means ALL of: a golden cross (50-day average above the 200-day average and the close above the 50-day average); a compressed range among the last 30 compression rows with a compression score >= 50; no open gap above the preset's max_gap_pct in the last 20 bars; a 20-day average volume >= the preset's min_volume; the close inside the preset's price band; at least finder_backtest.MIN_ROWS bars of history; and valid trade levels (entry, stop, target) taken from the compressed range's driver bar. Presets: signal (no price band, 100k volume, 3% gaps), pennyking (price <= 5, 500k volume, 8% gaps), maker (price 5-20, 250k volume, 6% gaps).
